newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia industrial output up 31.9 pct Jan-April.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia industrial output up 31.9 pct Jan-April.

text.p: Mongolia's industrial output increased by 31.95 percent in the first four months compared with the year-ago period, according to official statistics available on Friday.
Industrial output in January to April increased to 92.06 billion tugriks ($115.8 million), from 69.76 billion ($87.75 million) in the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bulletin said.
Output in April was 21.87 billion tugriks, up from 17 billion in the year-ago month, the bullein said.
The major increase was in the energy sector, with electricity production up 63.8 percent to 26.61 billion tugriks, from 16.24 billion tugriks a year-ago, it said.
Coal mines nearly doubled output in the first four months to 10.3 billion tugriks, from 5.53 billion in January-April last year.
